title: Mental health in elite athletes with and without disability
summary: This observational study aims to analyse the mental and physical health of top athletes. For this purpose, various questionnaires (4 on mental health and one on physical health) are sent out via an online system at 5 measurement points within one year. The measurement points are at the start of participation and 1 week, 4, 8 and 12 months after the start. Participation is open to top athletes who play their sport at least at a national level, are at least 18 years old, have a good command of German and/or English and agree to participate in the study. On the one hand, the mental health symptoms of top athletes with and without disabilities across different sports will be investigated over a preliminary period and, on the other hand, the reliability and internal consistency of two questionnaires (Sports Mental Health Assessment Tool and Patient Health Questionnaire-4) will be examined.

interventions.name: Elite athletes with and without disabilities complete the following online questionnaires at the start of the study: The Oslo Sport Trauma Research Centre Questionnaire on Health Problems (OSTRC-H2), the Sports Mental Health Assessment Tool (SMHAT-1), the Kessler Psychological Distress Scale (K-10),

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Elite athlete with participation in international competitions. 
Membership of a squad in their sport. 
Good knowledge of German and/or English.
Exclusion criteria:
None
